question: Should OpenClaw accept this scoped curated OpenRouter `/images` model-routing update now, after a conflict-safe rebase, or defer the work to the broader OpenRouter catalog policy?
rationale: The mechanics are reviewable, but this changes provider model routing for existing manual model IDs and intentionally chooses a curated-list policy instead of dynamic catalog discovery.

options.title: Accept After Conflict-Safe Rebase
options.body: Preserve current-main image-generation contracts, keep legacy preview IDs on chat completions, and accept `/images` routing for the added current OpenRouter IDs.

options.title: Narrow The Curated Set
options.body: Land only the model IDs with maintainer-accepted runtime proof and leave the rest to the broader OpenRouter catalog issue.

options.title: Defer To Catalog Policy
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it if maintainers want dynamic OpenRouter catalog discovery to own this product direction instead.

recommendation.title: Accept After Conflict-Safe Rebase
recommendation.body: Preserve current-main image-generation contracts, keep legacy preview IDs on chat completions, and accept `/images` routing for the added current OpenRouter IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across image-generation runtime, docs, and provider compatibility surfaces touched by the decision.
